title: Bears QB coach J.T. Barrett wants more efficiency, fewer superhero plays from Caleb Williams

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bears QB coach J.T. Barrett wants more efficiency, fewer superhero plays from Caleb Williams
sources.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams has shown plenty of ability to pull rabbits out of his hat over his first two seasons and he did that often enough to get the team into the divisional round of the playoffs last year.
